name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedLeaf.hiding_of_separator
title: Leaf separator gives perfect hiding of the mask in the noiseless (or noisy) path values
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, c_z (z in an index type) row vectors in R^k and l in R^k with c_z . l = 1 for all z. Then for any masks m, m', any noise family e_z and any function F of the family of path values, the sum over all matrices A in R^{k x n} of F((m + c_z A + e_z)_z) equals the same sum with m' in place of m. In other words, for uniform A the joint law of the path values does not depend on the mask.
